description: Selective containment in a shared worker: the first execution of the shared MCP server runs away, looping on 32 KiB uploads (4 in flight) through the keep-alive pool every session shares, toward a destination that serves one request at a time at 1 MB/s; the other executions make 25 sequential calls each (20 ms pause). A sent-byte budget of 128 KiB is enforced in the kernel on nobody (none: usage counted, nothing denied), on the whole worker (process: every call carries one identity, as a process-level limit sees it; allowance = 128 KiB plus 512 bytes per normal call), or on the runaway execution only (exec). Reference: each call's outcome and latency at the client and the bytes the destination received per request.
